page.layout: Running head at top left and page number "10"; one table with a year column and two columns (Oppidani, Agrarij); a centred heading in capitals below it; a second table of three years with names in one wide column; catchword "Idem" at bottom right.

main_text.l: 1595 | Ioannes Rengers them Post, ex agro.

page.notes: The catchword "Idem" is in italic at the foot right and is read as a catchword. The column captions "Oppidani" and "Agrarij" are transcribed as a list line. Table cells are separated by " | ". "Steé" and "Coenders.van" are transcribed as printed.
